settings.heading: BeeBlend - Himalayan Honey
settings.text: Unlike single-flower honey, BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey is crafted from the nectar of countless wildflowers that bloom throughout the Himalayan seasons. Every harvest offers its own unique balance of floral sweetness, delicate botanical notes and smooth natural richness, making every jar a true reflection of nature's ever-changing landscape.

settings.heading: From the Wild Himalayan highlands
settings.text:
A Symphony of Wildflowers in Every Spoonful

Collected by bees that forage across the pristine Himalayan foothills, BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey captures the rich diversity of nature in every jar. Crafted from the nectar of countless wildflowers blooming throughout the seasons, it offers a beautifully balanced flavour with delicate floral notes, subtle herbal undertones and a naturally smooth finish.

Traditionally enjoyed as part of a morning wellness ritual, this versatile raw honey is perfect for drizzling over breakfast, stirring into tea, blending into smoothies or adding a touch of natural sweetness to your favourite recipes. With its complex floral character, herbal notes and subtle spice, Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey offers a distinctive taste shaped by its diverse floral origins. Enjoy it stirred into warm drinks, drizzled over breakfast or incorporated into sweet and savoury recipes. Honey also holds cultural significance across the Himalayan region and has long featured in traditional and spiritual practices.

From your first spoonful to your daily wellness routine, BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey brings the untouched beauty and botanical richness of the Himalayas straight to your table.

settings.heading: Himalayan Hot Honey Halloumi Flatbreads
settings.text:
Culinary Application

Sweet, Salty and Gently Spiced

Golden halloumi, creamy garlic yoghurt and fresh salad are layered over warm flatbreads, then finished with a glossy drizzle of BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey infused with chilli and lemon.

The floral sweetness of the honey balances the salty halloumi beautifully, creating a colourful and satisfying dish that is perfect for quick dinners, relaxed lunches or sharing with friends.

settings.q: What is BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey?
settings.a: BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey is a raw honey produced from nectar collected by bees foraging across a diverse range of wildflowers in the Himalayan regions. Because it is multi-floral, its flavour reflects the variety of blossoms available during each seasonal harvest.

settings.q: What does Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey taste like?
settings.a: BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey has a complex yet balanced flavour with wild floral sweetness, delicate herbal notes and a subtle hint of spice. Its varied floral sources give it a richer character than many single-flower honeys.

settings.q: Where does BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey come from?
settings.a: BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey is harvested from high-altitude Himalayan regions, where bees forage among naturally occurring mountain wildflowers. BeeBlend lists the origin at approximately 2,000–3,000 metres in altitude.

Multi-floral honey is made from nectar collected from several different types of flowers rather than predominantly one floral source. BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey reflects the diverse wildflowers blooming throughout the Himalayan seasons, meaning natural variations between harvests can occur.

settings.q: What colour and texture is Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey?
settings.a: BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey ranges from deep amber to dark golden and has a rich texture. Its colour, aroma and flavour can naturally vary depending on the wildflowers available to the bees during each harvest.

settings.q: What is Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey best used for?
settings.a: BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey is versatile enough for breakfast, drinks and cooking. Drizzle it over yoghurt or porridge, stir it into tea, blend it into smoothies or use it to bring floral sweetness to marinades, glazes and recipes.

settings.q: How is Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey different from single-flower honey?
settings.a: Unlike monofloral honey produced predominantly from one blossom type, BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey comes from numerous Himalayan wildflowers. This creates a more complex combination of floral, herbal and subtly spiced flavour notes.

settings.q: How should I store BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey?
settings.a: Store BeeBlend Himalayan Multi-Flora Honey tightly sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Honey generally does not need refrigeration, and natural changes in colour, texture or crystallisation can occur over time.
